title: Three-term asymptotics for discrete Hardy--Rellich constants in high dimension
summary: Sharp Hardy--Rellich constants are spectral thresholds for operators with critical inverse-power potentials. Let $C_\ell(N)$ denote the optimal constant in the $\ell$th-order discrete Hardy--Rellich inequality on $\Z^N$. Recent independent work established the leading high-dimensional behavior $C_\ell(N)\sim2^\ell N^\ell$ for every fixed $\ell$. We determine the next two orders and prove \[ C_\ell(N)=2^\ell N^\ell+γ_\ell N^{\ell-1} +δ_\ell N^{\ell-2}+O_\ell(N^{\ell-3}), \] with explicit coefficients $γ_\ell$ and $δ_\ell$.
